simple.meaning: עֲצַב (ʻătsab) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to afflict.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 6:21. The surrounding contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עֲצַב (H6088) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: עֲצַב (ʻătsab) / H6088 is traced through Daniel 6:21 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H6088. atsab [ עֲצַב ] verb pain, grieve ( ᵑ7 (rare); see Biblical Hebrew I. עצב ); — Pe`al Passive participle , as adjective : עֲצִיב בְּקָל Dan 6:21 a pained voice (compare ᵑ7 Est 4:1 , ᵑ7 J Exod 12:31 ).
